environment: Node 24 + SQLite / in-process D1 adapter and private R2 test adapter; not a hosted identity penetration test

checks.name: Missing account identity returns 401
First account has no fabricated people or health data
Personal display preferences persist across requests
Two care recipients remain explicitly assigned
Role-specific invitations are issued as opaque tokens
Invitations attach an independent second account
An invitation cannot be reused
Recipient scopes prevent access to a second patient
Private self-assessments do not appear to other members
Unassigned task can be created without an assumed acceptance
Two competing task takeovers produce only one success
One person cannot accept on behalf of another
Substitution request retains existing responsibility
Medication plan uses structured amounts and units
Everyday helper cannot read or mutate medication data
Concurrent duplicate dose confirmations produce exactly one event
Dose correction requires a reason
Dose correction is append-only and preserves the original
Plan changes retain a historical revision
A dose outside the recorded schedule is rejected
Appointment completion produces a personal follow-up event
Repeated job processing does not duplicate notices
Snooze persists as a future server-side job
A draft follow-up remains private
A valid file is attached to the correct draft
Publishing makes result and attachment available to authorized users only
Unsafe file signatures are rejected
General export excludes private answers
QR share requires explicit consent and uses no health payload in token
Revoked QR share cannot be used again
Membership revocation blocks existing file access
Personal availability requires an actual time window
Overlapping windows are merged in the time balance
Nonexistent daylight-saving local time is rejected
Summer and winter dates retain the same local clock time
Unknown inventory is not converted into a fictional range
Structured FHIR export excludes personal questionnaires
Logos are actual SVG vectors without embedded raster data
Full SQLite backup and restore preserve tables and history
Server export contains exactly the selected recipient
Requested task creates a targeted in-app notice
Finite weekly series preserves local time across DST
Future series edits leave past and completed entries unchanged
Series edits reject moving instances to a different date
Expired and revoked invitations are both rejected
Rescheduling removes stale notices and replaces the pending reminder
A cancelled appointment never generates a follow-up prompt
Cross-case double booking reports a conflict without case details
Availability suggestions respect windows, absences and confirmed tasks
Declining a substitution keeps the coverage gap visible
Weekly jobs are unique per recipient circle and account
No unauthenticated medical AI endpoint is exposed
Date-only appointment has no invented clock time or reminder
A second independent circle preserves existing data and personal preferences
Private medication events stay private and are excluded from export
A private flag cannot bypass a helper health permission
Read-only health permission cannot be escalated through a private record
Completed care work cannot be forged for someone else
Invalid ending timestamps are rejected at the API boundary
